from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """A single paper from the collection, capturing its title and outgoing references to other provided papers."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the paper being processed")
    references: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other papers in the provided collection that this paper explicitly cites")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
